subject: Checkout fails after retry
body: EU customers hit a 500 on POST /checkout when the card is retried. The first attempt looks fine, the retry returns checkout_error. This is blocking renewals.

subject: EU checkout still broken
body: Following up on the checkout retry bug. We reproduced it again this morning: same 500, same checkout_error, still only EU cards. Three more customers wrote in about failed renewals.

subject: Customers blocked on checkout before today's call
body: Ahead of our 16:00 UTC call: the checkout retry failure is still live. Please bring a timeline for the hotfix. We cannot tell affected customers to retry.

subject: Still need the cap table
body: Checking in on the cap table and the option pool summary. Our partner meeting cannot proceed until those are in the data room.

subject: Deck and August metrics before the partner meeting
body: Please send the updated deck and August metrics before our check-in today. I need them in hand for the partner meeting.

body: Notes from standup are in the doc. No ask inside. Alex is holding the checkout hotfix.
